Notes: Forest forage (Blue Flash Butterfly, Branch, Pine Nut, Iceling Column): Dependable although the area's MinimumSpawnsPerDay is 0, because it rolls 0 to 5 a day all season (about 17 a week), which passes Jeff's Deep Woods test of a reasonable weekly supply; Stardew Valley Expanded's min-0 areas were 0 to 1 a day. | Cave forage (Nightshade Fruit, Ghost Flower, Geoberry, Ginseng): Chance at Custom_SDS.Cavebase (0 to 2 a day shared by four items), Dependable but year 2 in the ten caves. | Monster loot: every FTM monster drop is Chance, as vanilla's and Stardew Valley Expanded's are; the cave and Eastern Forest drops are year 2 with their maps. | Prize machines: written as Chance routes (a pull costs a coin that is itself a rare monster drop), year 2 because Old Coins drop only in the ten caves and Shining Apples only in the Eastern Forest. | Producer Framework Mod goods (jams, dried flowers, perfumes, ingots): 55 of the pack's 64 goods written as Machine routes generated from ProducerRules.json, each landing its input's earliest year-1 table plus the processing days (1500 minutes = 2 days, 10000 minutes = 7 days); Chance when the input is only had by luck. Left unknown because the input has no year-1 route: SDS_AstralfruitJam, SDS_Fluoriteingot, SDS_LanternfruitJam, SDS_Obsidianingot, SDS_WhiteMoonRoseDried, SDS_WhiteMoonRoseJam, SDS_WhiteMoonRosePerfume, SDS_citroniteingot, SDS_gynocarpJam. | YearTwoMaps Custom_SDS.Cave1 to Cave10 and Caveroom (and the two shops in Caveroom): the door at Custom_SDS.Cavebase 22,14 is walled off until the SDSCavebase.open bundle (99 each of Solar Essence, Void Essence, Slime and Bat Wing), and the monsters behind it have 500 to 1600 HP, above the Skull Cavern, so no year-1 player is counted as standing there. This is what takes the seasonless Midnight Carp row at Custom_SDS.Cave7 out of the pools. | MapWeeks (judged from the maps and events, the walk reads each as week 1): Custom_Woods2 week 3 (walled off until event 19215203, which needs Maple Syrup carried into Custom_Woods1); Custom_SecretForestLogcabin week 7 (Sariel 6 hearts); Custom_SDS.cliff week 3 (the 10,000g SDScliffroad.roadopen bundle); Custom_SDS.AngelRetreatHall week 5 (20 Solar Essence); Custom_SDS.sea week 5 (event 19215288, Hovsep 4 hearts and two rainy evenings); couture and jewelry week 12 (event 19215104: luoli 6 hearts, 100,000g earned and the Desert); the 2-heart homes week 3, Lucas's week 4, Teresa's week 10. | YearTwoMaps Eastern Forest (Custom_SDS.EasternForest1 to 3, _main, UnmannedHotel and its room, with the four Boo shops there): the forest is entered by TouchAction Warp tiles from Custom_SDS.AvaliaForest and is open from day 1, but each of its three maze maps holds 25 monsters a day of 300 to 800 HP, above the Skull Cavern (Jeff's Deep Woods ruling: depth matched by monsters). Week 9 would be the matching week, but a pooled fish does not take a map's week and a week ruling would move a Spring or Summer fish's gate into Fall, so the forest is ruled out of year 1 whole: its fish, loot and prize machine are not asked for (reported). | Secret Woods: Custom_Woods1 (open from the Forest's west edge on day 1) has a north exit into Woods, so with this mod the Secret Woods can be entered in week 1 without the Steel Axe; left at TLY's week 4, the later and safer reading (reported). | YearRulings NeverSell: the two wallet currencies (Old Coin, Shining Apple), the four ore node objects, Failed Cooking, the two party tokens, and the seven paper recipes nothing in the mod hands out. YearRulings YearOne: the nine paper recipes that come only as one-time letters (heart letters SDS.present.7 to 13 and two special order prizes), ruled like vanilla's mail gifts; they stay no route in gaps. | WeekRulings: the four Forest forage items at their season's first week (TLY's forage rule reads Data/Locations, not layer routes); the fish caught only at Custom_Woods2 (Globostoma Cinerea, Red Pomfret, Cat Octopus, Golden Carp, River Jelly) and Sturgeon (O)698, which the mod's seasonless row there makes an any-season fish, at week 3, when that map opens: a pooled fish does not take a map's week by itself. | Cooking stations (the mod's own minigame, 101 dishes on eight placed machines): no route is written; each dish also has a Data/CookingRecipes row with the same ingredients, which TLY reads, and the dishes still unrouted need an input that is itself unknown (reported). | Wolf Staff (W)SDS_WolfStaff: a one-time pickup at Custom_Woods1 4,22 each loop; a weapon, so nothing is written.
